facts.claim: Digital financial literacy and demographic factors including age, income, and occupation significantly explain digital financial inclusion in Indonesian households.
facts.quote: Conversely, DFL and other demographic factors including age, income, occupation significantly explain DFI in Indonesian household.

facts.claim: Digital health literacy is linked to an older adult's ability to use technology to search, browse, understand, and evaluate health information.
facts.quote: Implying digital health literacy on older adults also affects their ability to use digital technology to search, browse, understand, and evaluate health information to improve their health status.

facts.claim: Age, education, income, perceived health and social isolation are linked to internet access.
facts.quote: Socio-demographic characteristics particularly age, education, income, perceived health and social isolation also predict internet access.

facts.claim: There is a strong relationship between literacy skills and digital well-being among K-12 students.
facts.quote: The findings demonstrate a strong relationship between literacy skills and digital well-being among K-12 students.

research.angle: The sources focus on how literacy, demographics, and social support influence digital access and well-being rather than comparing the speed of platform adoption between generations.
research.verdict: The provided sources do not contain data comparing the speed of platform adoption between older adults and teenagers.
research.caveat: None of the sources provide comparative data on the rate of adaptation to social media interfaces between different age groups.
